styles.name: Amber and teal
styles.description: Favor amber highlights and restrained teal shadows. Keep neutral surfaces from drifting into oversaturated cyan.

styles.name: Warm neutral
styles.description: Shift the midtones gently toward warm neutrals. Hold whites near ivory and keep shadow color restrained.

styles.name: Cool neutral
styles.description: Shift neutral tones gently toward cool slate. Keep important warm local colors distinct from the cool balance.

styles.name: Silver monochrome
styles.description: Translate the colors into balanced silver monochrome. Keep a broad middle-gray scale between dense black and luminous white.

clauses.text: full gray scale from deep black to bright white

styles.name: Restrained sepia
styles.description: Translate color into warm sepia-brown tones. Keep highlights pale and avoid a uniform orange cast.

styles.name: Copper dusk
styles.description: Favor muted copper and russet midtones. Keep deep shadows neutral with small warm highlight accents.

styles.name: Sage and stone
styles.description: Favor muted sage greens and warm stone neutrals. Keep saturation low while preserving distinct local color boundaries.

clauses.text: muted sage green and stone neutrals

styles.name: Porcelain cool
styles.description: Favor pale blue-white and softly cooled neutral tones. Retain gentle midtone separation rather than washing out the forms.

styles.name: Rose ash
styles.description: Mix dusty rose highlights with soft ash-gray shadows. Keep the color impression understated and evenly balanced.

styles.name: Ochre earth
styles.description: Favor ochre, clay and muted earth colors. Let small pale accents separate adjacent warm masses.

styles.name: Jewel restraint
styles.description: Use deep jewel colors with restrained saturation. Preserve dark color separation rather than collapsing it into black.

clauses.text: rich emerald, sapphire and ruby shadows

styles.name: Chalk pastel
styles.description: Lift colors toward a chalky pastel range. Keep shadow values soft but maintain the main shape boundaries.

styles.name: Olive film
styles.description: Favor muted olive shadows and warm neutral midtones. Keep pale highlights slightly creamy rather than green.

styles.name: Cobalt and cream
styles.description: Favor cobalt blue and warm cream color relationships. Concentrate saturated blue in the strongest existing color regions.

styles.name: Indigo dusk
styles.description: Favor indigo shadows with gently violet midtones. Keep the brightest values softly cool and color-separated.

styles.name: Vermilion accent
styles.description: Use restrained neutrals with a vermilion accent on existing focal colors. Keep the red accent localized rather than tinting the entire image.

clauses.text: neutral tones with one vermilion red accent

styles.name: Moss and gold
styles.description: Favor deep moss green and muted golden tones. Keep highlights mineral and subdued rather than metallic yellow.

clauses.text: deep moss green and muted gold

styles.name: Lavender smoke
styles.description: Favor smoky lavender and cool gray color relationships. Keep soft warm highlights to preserve tonal depth.

styles.name: Sand and ink
styles.description: Favor warm sand midtones and deep ink-colored shadows. Keep a small number of pale highlights for graphic separation.

clauses.text: warm sand midtones, deep ink shadows

styles.name: Celadon wash
styles.description: Favor pale celadon greens and off-white neutrals. Keep the strongest local colors softly desaturated but recognizable.

styles.name: Charcoal compression
styles.description: Compress color toward charcoal and subdued neutral midtones. Keep narrow luminous highlights and readable dark detail.

styles.name: Cream lift
styles.description: Lift the darkest tones slightly and warm the pale values toward cream. Keep local color differences visible beneath the faded tonal balance.

styles.name: Acid yellow-green
styles.description: Favor an intentional acid-yellow and dark green relationship. Keep the pale color field clean and the dark shapes distinctly separated.

styles.name: Aubergine and peach
styles.description: Favor aubergine shadows and muted peach midtones. Use pale warm highlights without excessive red saturation.

styles.description: Synthetic glossy candy hues without changing the underlying visual medium.
